# answerr Pro (answerr.me)

> Deterministic Policy Compiler, AI Agent Safety Gate & Microsecond CPU Reflex Engine by ITouch Systems.

## Core Product Pages
- [Home & Kara Kutu Live Console](https://answerr.me/): Natural-language rule compilation, deterministic ALLOW / DENY / ESCALATE verdicts with full execution traces.
- [Policy Studio (Compiler)](https://answerr.me/pro/studio.html): Compile plain Turkish or English policies into signed deterministic rules with unit test checks.
- [Developer Docs & API Reference](https://answerr.me/pro/docs.html): Decision API v1.3 quickstart, authentication, human review queues, shadow mode, backtesting, webhooks, and rate limits.
- [Transparent Pricing](https://answerr.me/pro/pricing.html): Per-decision pricing without token or GPU fees (Free Discovery, Developer, Pro, Enterprise).
- [Research & Formal Foundations](https://answerr.me/pro/research.html): Lean 4 formal proofs, procedural escape dynamics, and CERN Zenodo / arXiv publications.
- [Live Workspace](https://answerr.me/chat.html): Interactive zero-latency spinal decision workspace.
- [System Status](https://answerr.me/pro/status.html): Real-time global reachability and API v1.3 latency telemetry.
